ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; the surface is predominantly low-intensity (black) with isolated high-intensity (white/grey) pixels accounting for approximately 10-15% of the visible area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. A distinct deep indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves along the outer edges leading to acute, slightly upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, high-intensity linear scratches visible; a prominent cluster of diagonal white lines is located on the upper-left lobe and vertical lines on the center-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of live barnacles (high-intensity white textured masses) are attached to the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Extensive circular and linear scarring covers approximately 40% of the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity pixel clusters at the furthest lateral points of the flukes indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
